The crash came from the secret being empty on fork PRs. The fix made the `--nvdApiKey` flag conditional, and it was merged as PR #6210 under TRUNK-6670. The PR-triggered runs were later removed entirely.

**Why it crashed only on fork PRs.** Until be8716784, the workflow also ran on `pull_request` to `master`. Fork PRs do not receive repository secrets, so `${{ secrets.NVD_API_KEY }}` expanded to an empty string. That left a bare `--nvdApiKey` with no value after it, and the Dependency-Check CLI failed with a missing-argument error. Because the flag was always passed, every fork PR failed whatever it changed. Pushes to the protected branches still had the secret, so they were unaffected.

**How the scan runs now when the key is missing.** The `args` block only adds the flag when the secret is set. The expression `${{ secrets.NVD_API_KEY != '' && format('--nvdApiKey {0}', secrets.NVD_API_KEY) || '' }}` expands to nothing when the key is absent, so the scan runs without an API key and uses rate-limited NVD access. The original version of this expression came in with #5799, and the fork-specific fix is in 8ec94d21 (#6210).

**Which change fixed it.** Commit 8ec94d21 (PR #6210, ticket TRUNK-6670, by suubi-joshua) changed that single argument line. Its diff replaces `--nvdApiKey ${{ secrets.NVD_API_KEY }}` with the conditional expression. The PR description states the cause: fork PRs have no access to the secret, so the CLI crashes on every such PR.

**Later change.** Commit be8716784 (2026-08-31, Jayasanka Weerasinghe, "Run OWASP dependency check on all 2.x branches and remove PR runs") removed the `pull_request` trigger and added `2.*.x` branches to the `push` trigger. Fork PRs therefore no longer run this scan at all. The conditional stays in place as a guard for the protected-branch runs. The commit message names no ticket, so I have not linked it to one.
